points.description: States that the water froze (turned to ice) and that water expands when it freezes, so the ice took up more space / pushed outward on the bottle, cracking it.
points.partial_credit: Half mark (0.5) for stating only that the water froze, or only that water expands when it freezes, without linking the expansion to the bottle cracking.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both the freezing of the water and the expansion of water on freezing as the reason the bottle cracked. A response giving only one of these two ideas earns half a mark. No marks for answers that do not mention freezing or expansion (e.g. 'the cold broke it'). Equivalent wording and correct alternative phrasing are accepted.
